silentZones.explanation: Sindhupalchok (pop 287,798) has a damage ratio of 75%, at or above the regional median. Its pre-event baseline was 5.9 local voices/day; allowing for the regional surge (x0.92) we expected 16.1 voices in 72 h and heard 10 (38% below expectation, residual 1.51). Rules fired: F (fusion with outage evidence). Independent evidence: night lights down 90%; 85% of cell sites reported down. Reported evacuation: 5% of population; after removing evacuees the district is still too quiet. Advisory flag: verify through another channel before acting.
